File convert · free, in your browser

Convert MT940 to Excel

MT940 is the SWIFT statement many banks send to bookkeeping programs. Open it as a workbook with one row per statement line, the opening and closing balances, and a check.

Convert MT940 to Excel

How to do it

  1. Drop the MT940 file on the page. It is recognised from its fields (:20:, :25:, :60F:), whatever its name.
  2. Bank statement to Excel (XLSX) is chosen for you. Choose Convert, then Download.
  3. The Transactions sheet lists every :61: line of every statement in the file, with the :86: text split into text and counterparty where the bank uses the German or Dutch layout.
  4. The Statement sheet checks that the opening balance plus the lines equals the closing balance.

Your files stay on this device: File convert runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Can one file hold several days?

Yes. Every statement in the file is read; the Account column says which account each line belongs to when there are several.

How are reversals shown?

A reversal (RC or RD) gets the sign of the money it moves and the word Reversal in the Status column.

Can I get CSV?

Yes. Choose Bank statement to CSV, or use the MT940 to CSV page.
